hero.eyebrow: ✦ Turn showing up into a game you're winning
hero.title: Your habits, tracked like a game you actually want to play.
hero.subtitle: {appName} is a habit tracker built around one board: every habit, every day of the month, filling in as you go. Streaks, XP, levels and badges — no guilt notifications, just the record.

features.title: Everything a spreadsheet had. Plus everything it couldn't.

board.title: The month board
board.text: One row per habit, one column per day. The whole month on one screen — no other tracker shows you this.

streaks.title: Streaks & records
streaks.text: Consecutive-day streaks per habit, plus your all-time record. The thing a paper checklist never totaled for you.

badges.title: Badges & levels
badges.text: XP for every tick, levels as you go, badges for perfect weeks and long streaks. Free gets 3 starter badges — Pro unlocks the rest.

skins.title: Board skins
skins.text: 8 cosmetic color themes for your board. 2 free, 6 with Pro — zero effect on your data, just your taste.

mood.title: Mood tracking
mood.text: Log how you felt each day and watch it line up against your consistency.

pause.title: Pause mode
pause.text: Going on vacation? Pause a habit and the days in between won't break your streak (Pro).

step1.title: Add your habits
step1.text: Wake up early, gym, reading — anything you want to build or quit.

step2.title: Check the box, daily
step2.text: One click. Optimistic, instant, no page reload. XP and streak update live.

step3.title: Level up
step3.text: Badges, board skins and a ranked list keep you honest and coming back.

cta.title: Day one is the only level that's hard.
